method: Five initial native image_gen atlases and the actual archived native correction calls after inspection of local references and generated poses. Missing, incomplete or clipped rows are replaced only by new native rows. Sharp only extracts alpha-separated cells, applies shared per-phase scale and baseline normalization, and builds review contacts. No limb, pose, clone, weapon or effect is procedurally painted or synthesized. Renderer-only body-stature metadata compensates differing source normalization while preserving the measured native pose-height ratio and baseline244; it never changes or crops a PNG.

nativeSources.reason: Human normal-phase forearms incorrectly remain mechanically armored in several native cells; super cells touch across their alpha seam. Replace only affected six human rows and super row, preserving the original four finale poses.

The original super row crosses two neighbouring native cells with opaque brass/sonic trails, and overwide effects mechanically shrink the enormous machine body. Four fresh compact super poses correct that row only.
